review: You must understand, in our tradition the text is the master of the melody and not its material, and there is no Byzantine chant on this website at all — Greek is offered and there is nothing behind it, which I record without complaint as a fact. I have chanted in my parish since I was nineteen. The old cantor who taught me by ear died in 2011 and I still hear his corrections. "The Scroll Begins to Sing" is doing what he did. I find most of this site theologically shallow and musically foreign and I have returned to this album four times, which irritates me. I would like to know who wrote it. There is no way to find out.
